steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Ethnic representation in media has historically marginalised, stereotyped, or excluded people of colour, but recent years have seen significant improvement.

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Traditional stereotypes: Black men as criminals or athletes; Asian people as terrorists or 'model minorities'; Latino people as criminals or domestic workers; Middle Eastern people as terrorists.

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Underrepresentation: ethnic minorities have been proportionally underrepresented in mainstream media, particularly in lead roles, directing, and writing positions.

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Tokenism: including a single ethnic minority character to appear diverse without giving them meaningful development or narrative importance. Token characters are often stereotypical.
